Welcome to the Neon Gradient Gauntlet—an epic, futuristic ML race visualization where 7 competitors optimize the same task under a tight latency budget. As the run progresses, models approach the Event Horizon: the point where improvements flatten and the gap between winners and losers becomes visible.

In this video you’ll see:
- Real-time standings and gradient “neon trails”
- Accuracy vs latency tradeoffs
- The moment each team hits the Event Horizon
